categories.label: Headline CPI
categories.description: All consumer goods and services; includes food and energy.

categories.label: Core CPI
categories.description: All items excluding food and energy; includes shelter.

categories.label: Food
categories.description: Food at home and food away from home.

categories.label: Groceries
categories.description: Food at home: purchases from grocery stores and similar outlets.

categories.label: Dining out
categories.description: Food away from home: restaurant, cafeteria and other prepared-food purchases.

categories.label: Energy
categories.description: Broad energy aggregate, including motor fuel and household energy.

categories.label: Gasoline
categories.description: Gasoline, all types. A component of the energy index.

categories.label: Shelter
categories.description: Housing services, including tenant rent and owners’ equivalent rent; excludes home-purchase prices and mortgage payments.

categories.label: Tenant rent
categories.description: Rent of primary residence, including existing rental agreements; different coverage from Zillow asking rents.

categories.label: Excluding shelter
categories.description: All items less shelter. Includes food and energy.
